sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar For the Petitioners : Ms. Nitu Sinha, Adv. For
the State : Mr. Someshwar Roy, A.P.P. ....
03/22.03.2023
The applicants who are in custody since 14.07.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Maheshpur P.S. Case No.142/2022.
The applicants have been made accused for the offence under Section 376(DA) of IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that even as per the allegation, they were standing outside the room where the crime has been committed.
Further, no active role has been assigned to them.
Further, they have failed to pay the fine as decided in the panchayati and as such this false case has been lodged.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicants and submitted that the victim girl has supported the allegation.
Considering the materials available on record, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicants on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly prayer for bail of the applicants stand rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
